name: get_pull_request_attachment
description: Fetch one image or file attached to an Origin-hosted pull request. url is an attachment URL exactly as pull_request_read returns it in the description, a review, or a comment: a cursor.com user-attachments URL, or a legacy upload-bucket URL. Only those upload shapes are accepted, and the URL must appear in that pull request's text; no other URL is ever fetched. An image of at most 3 MiB is returned as an image content block beside the JSON summary (delivery inline, with contentType and byteLength). A larger image, a recording, or another file is answered with delivery url: fetchUrl serves the bytes without further credentials, until expiresAt when the URL is signed, and reason says why (video, too_large, or not_an_image). kind is image, video, or file.

owner.description: Origin namespace (owner) slug, taken from list_namespaces or an earlier Origin result. A GitHub owner or org name is not an Origin namespace unless list_namespaces returns it.

name.description: Origin repository name within that namespace

url.description: Attachment URL exactly as pull_request_read returns it in the description, a review, or a comment of this pull request
